crossRefs.note: Then he released to them Barabbas, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.
Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to…
So Pilate then took Jesus, and flogged him.
“You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.
He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.

people.name: Pilate
people.line: Roman governor who presided over Jesus' trial

translations.web: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.
translations.bsb: So Pilate sentenced that their demand be met.
